messages:
alex: FYI hitting a weird race when cancelling generator streams during auth refresh. Seen a panic / `send on closed stream` in a small sample app.

maria: Can you paste a minimal repro? Which SDK version?

alex: go-sdk v0.12.3; small repro repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk-samples/resume-cancel-bug

alex: Quick snippet:
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()
g, _ := client.Generator(ctx, model, opts)
for g.Next() {
  fmt.Print(g.Value().Text)
}
if err := g.Err(); err != nil { log.Println("gen err:", err) }
// sometimes Close() panics here: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer deref
_ = g.Close()
```

kevin: I suspect auth refresh triggers a reconnect while ctx cancel races with stream close. Workaround: spawn a goroutine that calls g.Close() on ctx.Done() and ignore double-close panic.

maria: Can you also paste the runtime/log output? What stacktrace do you get?

alex: Logs show: \"panic: send on closed stream\" + stack pointing at stream.sendLocked -> stream.close. Repro rate ~30% locally.

sam: Suggestion: SDK should make generator.Close() idempotent and map context cancellation to a clear error (ErrCanceled). Also Next() should return false + Err==context.Canceled instead of leaving callers in an ambiguous state.

maria: Agree. Small ergonomic tweak: default Close to be idempotent; don't require consumers to special-case it.

kevin: Another DX improvement: provide a helper `NextWithCtx(ctx)` or an iterator wrapper so consumption patterns handle ctx cancel naturally. Example: `for item, ok := gen.NextWithErr(ctx) { ... }`.

alex: I'll open a tiny PR that makes Close idempotent and adds a test harness that simulates auth refresh + ctx cancel. Filing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/543

ci-bot: test failure on branch: generator-close-idempotent — flaky auth-resume test failed (run 12/100) :eyes:

maria: Thanks. If PR lands, let's add a short sample in onboarding that shows the recommended cancel pattern so folks don't hit this during ramp.

sam: Also update quickstart docs: show `defer gen.Close()` and `if err := gen.Err(); err != nil { ... }` pattern + a note about auth/reconnect races.

alex: Cool. I'll add the sample + e2e and tag y'all. :thumbsup:
